description: "Withdrawal complete" screen (dark theme) for a WETH withdrawal with no unwrap. Shows Status: Completed and a single "Received: 0.0001 WETH" row — there is no row showing what was actually redeemed/sent, unlike bug_screenshot_2.

"Withdrawal complete" screen (dark theme) for an unwrap withdrawal. Shows Status: Completed and a two-sided row — "Withdrawal amount: 0.0001 WETH → Received: 0.02098338... ETH" — correctly reporting both what was sent and what arrived.
